title: Assistant Clinical Professor of Law
bio: Noel Roycroft is the Director of the Harvard Law School Transactional Law Clinics (“TLC”). At TLC, Noel trains and supervises students representing clients in the broader Massachusetts community on cases spanning the transactional spectrum. Noel focuses her legal practice on representing entrepreneurs, small businesses, social enterprises, non-profits, community groups, and creatives. She has experience in […]
research_interests: Contracts Corporate and Transactional Law Poverty Law and Economic Justice
